Class ContributorRequirementsTestbed

java.lang.Object
testingAutomation.ContributorRequirementsTestbed
public final class ContributorRequirementsTestbed extends Object

Title: ContributorRequirementsTestbed Class.

Description: The team's requirement-driven testbed for every TP2 Contributor requirement (Task 7). Each requirement in ContributorRequirement is covered by two or more tests, at least one positive (valid use succeeds) and one negative (invalid use is refused or handled safely). Each test is its own method with its own Javadoc, written to the team's test Javadoc template: the requirement tested, how the code checks it, and how to read its output.

The tests use the real integrated code: the session-bound Database and its LessonStore, the LessonsLearned and LessonsLearnedList entity classes, the experience recognizer, and the Contributor GUI's non-visual layer (the gateway, Rules, and the Delete window's model). They run against a private, file-backed H2 database in a temporary folder, so they never touch the application's real data, and that file lets CR-16 close and restart the database to prove persistence.

How to run: run this class as a Java Application in Eclipse (no arguments), or run python3 dev.py test from the TP2 folder to run this testbed together with every other team suite. No GUI is opened.

How to read the output: every test prints a header line with its requirement ID, test number, POSITIVE or NEGATIVE, and title. Each check under it prints what was expected and what was observed, then "ok" or "FAILED". The test ends with PASS only when every check succeeded. The final summary lists, for each requirement, how many positive and negative tests passed, then the totals. A correct build ends with "Tests failed: 0" and "Requirement coverage: complete", and exits with status 0; any failure exits with status 1.

    • cr01ValidLessonIsStoredForAuthor

      private static void cr01ValidLessonIsStoredForAuthor() throws Exception

      Test CR-01 T1 (positive)

      Requirement tested: CR-01, a Contributor can add a new lesson by entering its core information, and the stored lesson belongs to the signed-in Contributor.

      How it is checked: a new Contributor signs in and calls LessonsLearned.create (which calls Database.addLesson) with four valid fields. The lesson is then read back from the database with Database.getLesson.

      How to read the output: the first check expects SUCCESS with an ID greater than 0; the second expects the stored owner and title to equal what was entered. PASS means the lesson was stored for its author.

      Throws:
      Exception

    • cr01NoSessionStoresNothing

      private static void cr01NoSessionStoresNothing() throws Exception

      Test CR-01 T2 (negative)

      Requirement tested: CR-01, only a signed-in Contributor can add a lesson.

      How it is checked: the session is cleared (as after logout) and Database.addLesson is called with an otherwise valid lesson; the Contributor then signs in and counts their lessons.

      How to read the output: the first check expects UNAUTHORIZED; the second expects 0 stored lessons. PASS means nothing is stored without a signed-in Contributor.

      Throws:
      Exception

    • cr01ForgedOwnerIsRefused

      private static void cr01ForgedOwnerIsRefused() throws Exception

      Test CR-01 T3 (negative)

      Requirement tested: CR-01, the stored lesson belongs to the signed-in Contributor, so a Contributor cannot add a lesson in another Contributor's name.

      How it is checked: Alice signs in and submits a lesson whose owner field says Bob; Bob's list is then read while Bob is signed in.

      How to read the output: expect NOT_OWNER and 0 lessons for Bob. PASS means a forged owner is refused.

      Throws:
      Exception

    • cr02BoundaryValuesAreAccepted

      private static void cr02BoundaryValuesAreAccepted() throws Exception

      Test CR-02 T1 (positive)

      Requirement tested: CR-02, values exactly at the lower limits are valid: a 5-character Title and 20-character Situation and Lesson Text.

      How it is checked: LessonRecognizer.checkForValidLesson is called on the boundary lesson, and the lesson is then added through Database.addLesson.

      How to read the output: expect an empty recognizer message (shown as "") and SUCCESS. PASS means the limits are inclusive.

      Throws:
      Exception

    • cr02ShortTitleIsRefused

      private static void cr02ShortTitleIsRefused() throws Exception

      Test CR-02 T2 (negative)

      Requirement tested: CR-02, a Title shorter than 5 characters is refused with a message that explains the fix, and nothing is stored.

      How it is checked: a lesson with the 4-character title "Plan" is checked by LessonRecognizer and submitted to Database.addLesson; the Contributor's list is counted.

      How to read the output: expect a non-empty message that mentions the title, INVALID_INPUT, and 0 stored lessons.

      Throws:
      Exception

    • cr02UnknownCategoryIsRefused

      private static void cr02UnknownCategoryIsRefused() throws Exception

      Test CR-02 T3 (negative)

      Requirement tested: CR-02, the Category must come from the fixed list.

      How it is checked: a lesson with the category "Cooking", which is not in LessonsLearned.CATEGORIES, is submitted to Database.addLesson.

      How to read the output: expect INVALID_INPUT and 0 stored lessons.

      Throws:
      Exception

    • cr02OverlongLessonTextIsRefused

      private static void cr02OverlongLessonTextIsRefused() throws Exception

      Test CR-02 T4 (negative)

      Requirement tested: CR-02, Lesson Text longer than 2000 characters is refused.

      How it is checked: a lesson whose Lesson Text has 2001 characters is submitted to Database.addLesson.

      How to read the output: expect INVALID_INPUT and 0 stored lessons.

      Throws:
      Exception

    • cr03UnlockedFieldIsUpdated

      private static void cr03UnlockedFieldIsUpdated() throws Exception

      Test CR-03 T1 (positive)

      Requirement tested: CR-03, a Contributor can update an unlocked field of their own lesson; the ID and owner do not change.

      How it is checked: Alice adds a lesson, changes its Situation through LessonsLearned.update (which calls Database.updateLesson), and reads it back.

      How to read the output: expect SUCCESS, then the new Situation with the same ID and owner.

      Throws:
      Exception

    • cr03InvalidUpdateChangesNothing

      private static void cr03InvalidUpdateChangesNothing() throws Exception

      Test CR-03 T2 (negative)

      Requirement tested: CR-03, an update with invalid values is refused and the stored lesson is unchanged.

      How it is checked: Alice submits an update whose Situation is only 5 characters and then reads the lesson back.

      How to read the output: expect INVALID_INPUT and the original Situation.

      Throws:
      Exception

    • cr04OtherFieldsStayEditable

      private static void cr04OtherFieldsStayEditable() throws Exception

      Test CR-04 T1 (positive)

      Requirement tested: CR-04, while one field is locked the Contributor can still change the other, unlocked fields.

      How it is checked: the Curator locks the Title; Alice then submits an update that keeps the Title and changes only the Situation.

      How to read the output: expect SUCCESS and the new Situation stored.

      Throws:
      Exception

    • cr04LockedFieldCannotChange

      private static void cr04LockedFieldCannotChange() throws Exception

      Test CR-04 T2 (negative)

      Requirement tested: CR-04, a locked field cannot be changed by the Contributor.

      How it is checked: the Curator locks the Category; Alice submits an update that changes the Category from Testing to Design and the lesson is read back.

      How to read the output: expect LOCKED and the stored Category still Testing.

      Throws:
      Exception

    • cr04EditRulesRefuseLockedField

      private static void cr04EditRulesRefuseLockedField() throws Exception

      Test CR-04 T3 (negative)

      Requirement tested: CR-04, the Edit window's rules refuse a change to a locked field before anything is sent to the database.

      How it is checked: the Curator locks the Lesson Text; the GUI gateway reads the lesson as Alice and Rules.editable is given a draft that changes the Lesson Text.

      How to read the output: expect a refusal whose message names the locked field.

      Throws:
      Exception

    • cr05LockedLessonRefusesEdits

      private static void cr05LockedLessonRefusesEdits() throws Exception

      Test CR-05 T1 (negative)

      Requirement tested: CR-05, a whole-lesson lock prevents every core-field change.

      How it is checked: the Curator locks the whole lesson and Alice submits an update that changes only the Situation (a field with no field lock).

      How to read the output: expect LOCKED and the original Situation.

      Throws:
      Exception

    • cr05LockedLessonRefusesExperience

      private static void cr05LockedLessonRefusesExperience() throws Exception

      Test CR-05 T2 (negative)

      Requirement tested: CR-05, a whole-lesson lock also prevents adding experience information.

      How it is checked: the Curator locks the whole lesson and Alice calls Database.addExperience with a valid experience; her experiences are then counted.

      How to read the output: expect a refusal saying the lesson is locked, and 0 experiences.

      Throws:
      Exception

    • cr05UnlockedLessonAcceptsEdit

      private static void cr05UnlockedLessonAcceptsEdit() throws Exception

      Test CR-05 T3 (positive)

      Requirement tested: CR-05, the lock is the only thing preventing the edit: once the Curator unlocks the lesson, the same edit succeeds.

      How it is checked: the Curator locks and then unlocks the lesson; Alice submits the Situation edit.

      How to read the output: expect SUCCESS after the unlock.

      Throws:
      Exception

    • cr06ConfirmedDeleteRemovesLesson

      private static void cr06ConfirmedDeleteRemovesLesson() throws Exception

      Test CR-06 T1 (positive)

      Requirement tested: CR-06, a confirmed delete removes an unlocked lesson and its linked experience records.

      How it is checked: Alice adds a lesson and an experience with two member rows, then the Delete window's model (ModelLessonDelete) is called with confirmed = true (the user answered Yes). The experience and member-effort rows are counted directly in the database file before and after, because no session can read them once the lesson is gone.

      How to read the output: expect 1 experience and 2 effort rows before, true from the model, the lesson no longer readable, and 0 experience and 0 effort rows after.

      Throws:
      Exception

    • cr06NoKeepsLesson

      private static void cr06NoKeepsLesson() throws Exception

      Test CR-06 T2 (negative)

      Requirement tested: CR-06, answering No (the default) deletes nothing.

      How it is checked: ModelLessonDelete.remove is called with confirmed = false, and Database.deleteLesson is also called directly with confirmed = false.

      How to read the output: expect false, CANCELLED, and the lesson still present.

      Throws:
      Exception

    • cr07FieldLockPreventsDelete

      private static void cr07FieldLockPreventsDelete() throws Exception

      Test CR-07 T1 (negative)
